key_findings: DA robustly inhibits pharmacologically isolated GABAergic eIPSCs in ACC via postsynaptic D2R and G-protein activity.
CFA inflammation and DA do not alter E/I balance in ACC neurons, but DA reduces sEPSC frequency only in CFA mice.
